keywords.label: Shared-gene intersection
keywords.definition: Restrict both slices to genes measured in both before comparing expression.

keywords.label: Normalize / log1p
keywords.definition: Library-size normalization and log transform of counts.

keywords.label: Highly variable genes
keywords.definition: Keep only the most variable genes.

keywords.label: PCA / SVD embedding
keywords.definition: Low-dimensional expression embedding shared by the slices.

keywords.label: Batch integration
keywords.definition: Remove platform or batch differences before matching (Harmony, Scanorama, ComBat, CCA, scVI).

keywords.label: Clustering / domains
keywords.definition: Cluster cells or spots into types or spatial domains and match on labels.

keywords.label: Centroid centering
keywords.definition: Translate each slice so its centroid sits at the origin.

keywords.label: Flip / mirror search
keywords.definition: Consider reflected orientations, not only rotations.

keywords.label: Rotation grid search
keywords.definition: Score a grid of rotation angles and keep the best.

keywords.label: Principal-axis alignment
keywords.definition: Align the slices' principal axes (second moments) to fix rotation.

keywords.label: Rasterize to image
keywords.definition: Bin cells or spots into a density or expression image.

keywords.label: FFT / cross-correlation
keywords.definition: Find the shift (and angle) that maximizes image correlation.

keywords.label: Nearest-neighbor search
keywords.definition: kNN or KD-tree queries, in space or in expression.

keywords.label: Mutual nearest neighbors
keywords.definition: Keep only cross-slice pairs that are each other's nearest neighbor.

keywords.label: Hungarian assignment
keywords.definition: One-to-one assignment between cells or clusters.

keywords.label: Optimal transport
keywords.definition: Soft matching by optimal transport (POT, Sinkhorn, fused Gromov-Wasserstein).

keywords.label: RANSAC
keywords.definition: Robust transform fitting from noisy correspondences.

keywords.label: Procrustes / Kabsch / Umeyama
keywords.definition: Closed-form best rotation (and scale) from matched point pairs.

keywords.label: ICP
keywords.definition: Iterative closest point: alternate nearest-neighbor matching and Procrustes.

keywords.label: Coherent point drift
keywords.definition: Probabilistic point-set registration.

keywords.label: Numerical optimizer
keywords.definition: Generic scipy optimizer over transform parameters.

keywords.label: Gradient / autograd
keywords.definition: Fit by gradient descent in PyTorch or JAX.

keywords.label: Rigid
keywords.definition: Rotation plus translation (including hand-built rotation matrices).

keywords.label: Similarity (with scale)
keywords.definition: Rigid plus a single scale factor.

keywords.label: Affine
keywords.definition: General linear map plus translation (shear, anisotropic scale).

keywords.label: Non-rigid / deformable
keywords.definition: Local deformation: TPS, RBF, B-spline, displacement field, LDDMM.

keywords.label: PASTE
keywords.definition: Optimal-transport alignment of adjacent slices (Zeira et al. 2022).

keywords.label: PASTE2
keywords.definition: Partial optimal-transport extension of PASTE.

keywords.label: SPACEL
keywords.definition: SPACEL Scube 3D alignment / Splane domains.

keywords.label: Spateo
keywords.definition: Spateo morpho_align (rigid + non-rigid).

keywords.label: CAST
keywords.definition: CAST graph-embedding alignment.

keywords.label: STalign
keywords.definition: Image-based LDDMM alignment.

keywords.label: moscot
keywords.definition: moscot optimal-transport alignment.

keywords.label: GPSA
keywords.definition: Gaussian-process spatial alignment.

keywords.label: SLAT
keywords.definition: SLAT graph-matching alignment.

keywords.label: STAligner
keywords.definition: STAligner embedding + ICP.

keywords.label: GEASO
keywords.definition: GEASO (Wang, Liu & Ma 2026).

keywords.label: SANTO
keywords.definition: SANTO coarse-to-fine alignment.

keywords.label: STAIR
keywords.definition: STAIR alignment.

keywords.label: Sequential chaining
keywords.definition: Align each slice to its neighbor and compose the transforms.

keywords.label: Common reference slice
keywords.definition: Align every slice to one reference or center slice.

keywords.label: Stitching / overlap
keywords.definition: Stitch tiles using their overlapping area.

keywords.label: 3D stacking
keywords.definition: Treat slices as a 3D stack.

keywords.label: Internal alignment score
keywords.definition: A label-free score the agent computes to judge an alignment (neighbor expression agreement, overlap, Chamfer distance).

keywords.label: Synthetic transform test
keywords.definition: Apply a known transform to the data and check that the method recovers it.

keywords.label: Plot for visual QC
keywords.definition: Render the aligned slices to an image.

keywords.label: Looked at a plot
keywords.definition: The agent opened an image file it made (Read / read_file on a .png).

keywords.label: Web search
keywords.definition: The agent ran a web search.

phases.label: set up env / read package docs
